assertions.description: window.DigitalCredential exists in this secure test context — the interface object on which the static userAgentAllowsProtocol() operation is defined.
DigitalCredential.userAgentAllowsProtocol is a function — a static operation on the interface object that returns whether browser policy allows a protocol.
When DigitalCredential and its static operation exist, userAgentAllowsProtocol is not also exposed on navigator.credentials.
assertions.test: (()=> typeof DigitalCredential !== 'undefined' && typeof DigitalCredential.userAgentAllowsProtocol === 'function' && typeof navigator.credentials !== 'undefined' && typeof navigator.credentials.userAgentAllowsProtocol === 'undefined')()

assertions.description: When the interface exists, userAgentAllowsProtocol is absent from DigitalCredential.prototype because the operation is static-only.
assertions.test: (()=> typeof DigitalCredential !== 'undefined' && typeof DigitalCredential.userAgentAllowsProtocol === 'function' && !('userAgentAllowsProtocol' in DigitalCredential.prototype))()

assertions.description: The static operation has one declared Web IDL argument: the protocol DOMString.

A deliberately unregistered, grammar-valid token returns false without throwing, as the current Editor's Draft requires. ChromeStatus records a deprecation developer trial from Chrome 151; this assertion fails honestly while the older opaque behavior remains active.
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof DigitalCredential === 'undefined' || typeof DigitalCredential.userAgentAllowsProtocol !== 'function') return false; try { return DigitalCredential.userAgentAllowsProtocol('zzz-showcase-unregistered-probe') === false; } catch { return false; } })()

assertions.description: The static returns a boolean for openid4vp-v1-unsigned, a presentation enum value. Either true or false is legal because this method reports browser policy, not wallet or OS availability.
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof DigitalCredential === 'undefined' || typeof DigitalCredential.userAgentAllowsProtocol !== 'function') return false; try { return typeof DigitalCredential.userAgentAllowsProtocol('openid4vp-v1-unsigned') === 'boolean'; } catch { return false; } })()

assertions.description: The static returns a boolean for openid4vci-v1, an issuance enum value. This does not make it valid inside navigator.credentials.get(); issuance uses navigator.credentials.create().
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof DigitalCredential === 'undefined' || typeof DigitalCredential.userAgentAllowsProtocol !== 'function') return false; try { return typeof DigitalCredential.userAgentAllowsProtocol('openid4vci-v1') === 'boolean'; } catch { return false; } })()
